scope: Exact model and in-memory DOM/timers. No rendered or physical-device check.
checks: Fresh measurements, including genuine zero, take priority over Google; zero does not light activity
Expiry is continuous, the original support clock fades into dated Google, and missing reference sectors retain original decay
Offline Finance boots with all 16 dated Google tiles and one request per source; fallback creates no measured movement
Finance resumes live, fades, reaches Google, and preserves measured median, movement index and payout eligibility
Mixed coverage falls back per sector without replacing fresh sectors or changing their colors
Hero uses the same downtime baseline and remains a single read-only link to Finance
Untouched hero rotates every six seconds; hover or arrows reveal Play; explicit Play resumes and manual pause persists
Swipe selection, hidden-tab suspension, inactive-card focusability and reduced motion are preserved
